import java.util.Scanner;

public class GeneticEngineering {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = sc.nextLine();
        sc.close();

        int res = 0;
        int n = str.length();
        int i = 0;
        
        while (i < n) {
            char currentChar = str.charAt(i);
            int j = i;
            
            while (j < n && str.charAt(j) == currentChar) {
                j++;
            }
            
            int count = j - i;
            // For even length sequences, we need to break them by inserting one character
            // to make all maximal sequences have odd length
            if (count % 2 == 0) {
                res++;
            }
            
            i = j;
        }
        
        System.out.print(res);
    }
}
